basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 23.' and it opens 'Vers. 23. Filii Aran Hus. A quo terra Hus in Job legitur, quam LXX terram appellant'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 23. Filii Aran Hus. A quo terra Hus in Job legitur, quam LXX terram appellant Ausititem, id est Australem. Et Hul. A quo Armenii. Gether. A quo Acarnani. Mesi. Quos LXX Mosoch vocant, id est, Moeones.
